test_reverse_structure: test the reverse_structure function to reverse the nesting order of children in an NLTK parse tree
test_drop_pos_tags: test the drop_pos_tags function to remove POS-tagged nodes from an NLTK parse tree
test_get_terminals: test the get_terminals function to extract leaf terminal tokens from an NLTK parse tree
test_make_left_branching: test the make_left_branching function to restructure an NLTK parse tree into left-branching form
test_make_right_branching: test the make_right_branching function to restructure an NLTK parse tree into right-branching form
